data.title: Income tax assessment 2024: €1,236 to pay
data.summary: Finanzamt Musterbach issued the 2024 income tax assessment dated 31 December 2025. It shows an additional payment of €1,236.00, due on 5 February 2026.
data.explanation: This is your tax assessment (Steuerbescheid) for 2024. Your income tax was set at €15,130.00, and €13,894.00 was already withheld through payroll tax, so you owe €1,236.00 more. Transfer it by 5 February 2026 to the tax office's account, using the tax number as the payment reference. If you disagree with the assessment, you may file an objection (Einspruch) in writing, electronically or in person at the tax office. The app shows the deadline for this. If you don't pay on time, late payment surcharges may follow. A tax adviser can help if you are unsure.
data.tax_note: Income tax assessment for 2024; it also confirms that your claimed craftsman services (Handwerkerleistungen, § 35a EStG) were accepted.
